temperature_c.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeGroup(o.result_time, $__interval, NULL),
    CASE 
        WHEN MAX(o.result) - MIN(o.result) >= 2 OR AVG(o.result) < 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE AVG(CASE WHEN d.name = 'Air temperature (avg.)' THEN 
            CASE 
            WHEN validity_id = 2 AND $thing_location != 57 THEN NULL
            
            ELSE round(o.result::numeric, 3) END 
        END)
    END AS avg_temp
FROM
    sensorthings_observation o
INNER JOIN
    sensorthings_datastream d ON o.datastream_id = d.id
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(o.result_time)
    AND d.thing_id = $thing_location
    AND NOT $thing_location IN (99)

    AND d.name = 'Air temperature (avg.)'
GROUP BY
    1
ORDER BY
    1;

relative_humidity_pct.rawSql:
SELECT
    o.result_time AS time, 
    d.name AS metric,
    AVG(CASE 
            WHEN validity_id = 2 THEN null 
            ELSE o.result 
        END) AS result
FROM
    sensorthings_observation o 
INNER JOIN
    sensorthings_datastream d ON o.datastream_id = d.id
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(o.result_time)
    AND d.thing_id = $thing_location
    
    AND d.name = 'Relative humidity (avg.)'
GROUP BY
    1, 2
ORDER BY
    1;

gust_kmh.rawSql:
select o.result_time as time, 
d.name as metric,
3.6*max(case when validity_id = 2 then null else o.result end) as result
from sensorthings_observation o 
inner join sensorthings_datastream d on o.datastream_id = d.id
where $__timeFilter(o.result_time)
and d.thing_id = $thing_location
and d.name = 'Wind speed (max.)'
group by 1,2
order by 1

wind_kmh.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(o.result_time, $__interval, NULL), 
d.name as metric,
3.6*avg(case when validity_id = 2
THEN null
else o.result end) as result
from sensorthings_observation o 
inner join sensorthings_datastream d on o.datastream_id = d.id
where $__timeFilter(o.result_time)
and d.thing_id = $thing_location
and d.name = 'Wind speed (avg.)'
group by 1, 2
order by 1

pressure_hpa.rawSql:
select o.result_time as time, 
d.name as metric,
avg(case when validity_id = 2 then null  
         when $thing_location = 39 AND o.result_time BETWEEN '2022-02-23T17:10:00.000Z' AND '2022-07-19T10:00.000Z' then null 
         else round(o.result::numeric, 1) end) as result
from sensorthings_observation o 
inner join sensorthings_datastream d on o.datastream_id = d.id
where $__timeFilter(o.result_time)
and d.thing_id = $thing_location and d.thing_id not in (99)
and d.name = 'Atmosferic pressure (avg.)'

group by 1,2
order by 1

wind_direction.rawSql:
select o.result_time as time, 
d.name as metric,
avg(case when validity_id = 2 then null else o.result end) as result
from sensorthings_observation o 
inner join sensorthings_datastream d on o.datastream_id = d.id
where $__timeFilter(o.result_time)
and d.thing_id = $thing_location
and d.name = 'Wind direction (avg.)'
group by 1,2
order by 1
